Confidential
Ms Tracy Grimshaw
Dear Tracy Grimshaw,
I would like to introduce myself, my name is Jacqueline Pearce, I was born an Australian citizen and have
resided in Australia during my life time of 50 years.
I have obtained numerous qualifications, including Business Management, Business Administration,
Business Development (Business Plan development), Fashion Design, Nail Technician, Published Author,
author under contract with publishing house Austin Macauley Publishers, London, and have been involved
in numerous community and council projects, Government developments and was a registered participant
in the Flinders University, Adelaide Venture Dorm Program and a participant in the Eventbrite, Women in
Business Organisation.
I have an extensive employment history, of which I gained valuable employment skills and opportunities to
advance my directions in Business Development and creating my own paths, directions and to reach my
goals of creating, developing and establishing my own business and businesses. I have a natural ability and
Entrepreneurial qualities and skills, of which I wished to develop and establish myself in world of business.
Following surviving a Near Death Experience of a violent relationship at the age of 19, which resulted in
and an abusive marriage of 14 years, that resulted in a Restraining Order being placed on the Ex
husband, I stepped out of the shadows of abuse at the age of 36 and set out to explore the opportunities of
establishing a Professional career of Business Development.
At the age of 22, 1993 I gave birth to twin boys, my first born children, one of which suffered from severe
EIR which resulted in severe discomfort and crying in the middle of the night each time he would roll
over onto his stomach in his sleep. Having obtained a Fashion Design degree at the age of 15 I set out to
ease the discomfort of my infant son suffering from thel=condition. I came up with a solution to the
problem by designing and sewing an Infant Sleep Positioner, a sling that wrapped around my infant sons
stomach, held in place by Velcro and straps that attached to the cots bars to secure his sleeping position,
and stop him from rolling over onto his stomach. The infant Sleep Positioner , baby sleeping sling was a
success and my son no longer suffered this discomfort and began to sleep through the night. At the time I
was residing in Willimulka, South Australia in a small, isolated farm house with my Defacto partner, father
of the children, who in 1996 became my husband.
This design, Infant Sleep Positioner was the first of my developments, which resulted in Intellectual
Property Theft in the Privacy of my own Home.
Refer to Stage IA.1 - Report
Following my divorce of the marriage in 2007 I set out to achieve my Professional goals, of which I had
been denied at age 14, a career in modelling and a University Degree in Medical Science, but had remained
my focus, passion and aspirations of my ambitious goals throughout the years of my sacrifice of marriage
and raising children.
As a single mother of 4 children from the marriage I began the journey of establishing a Professional Career
and commenced on the continual development of a Business Plan that I had begun in 2006, prior to the end
of my marriage. I enrolled in numerous courses to further develop my business qualifications and skills

EFTA00267051

 and became a registered client of the Regional Development Board, Port Pirie, giving me access to
Business Advisors, to further develop the Business Plan, and the goal of establishing my own business.
The Business Plan remained in Hand written form only, between the years of 2006 - 2009, while I
conducted the extensive Market Research into the Medical Industry and communities to complete the
Business Plans business infrastructure, objectives, progressive advancement and to secure Medical
Professionals into the correct Professional structures of the business.
In 2009 the Business Plan was completed and installed on a newly purchased business computer, and the
process of applying for funding and establishment of the business plan, The Specialist Medical Centre,
involving the centralisation of Medical Specialists operating from within one centre began.
Within the Hand written form of the 2006 Business Plan of The Specialist Medical Centre another
advancement business development, to be utilised and operated within the Medical Centre was in the
designed, developmental stages, and to be completed and implemented into the centre upon establishment
and operation of the centre. This Business development was named M.S.I.C, a communication tool to aid
and assist Medical Professionals and the patients referral system.
This continuous development, including conducting numerous Market Research amongst Medical
Professionals and Medical Centres commenced in 2009, and continued until 2012.
